description: This file defines the PHP class TemplateEncrypt, which extends TemplateField and implements encryption-related behavior for a custom field in SuiteCRM. It includes methods to save the field configuration and retrieve its database definition.

classes.name: TemplateEncrypt
classes.description: A class extending TemplateField to define an encrypted custom field type in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Sets the type to 'encrypt', sets a custom ext3 property, and calls the parent save method to persist the field configuration.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Retrieves the parent field definition and adds the database type from ext3 property.
